VIA HAND DELIVERY AND ELECTRONIC FILING 

The Honorable Scott S.  Harris 
Clerk of the Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C.  20543 

Re :  Comcast Corp. v.  Nat 'l Ass 'n of African American-Owned Media, No.  18-1171 

Dear Mr.  Harris: 

I  am  counsel  of  record  for  petitioner  in  the  above-referenced  case.  Petitioner  hereby 
respectfully requests a fourteen-day extension of time, to and including August 8,  2019, to file 
its  opening  brief  and  the  joint  appendix.  Counsel  for  respondents  has  consented  to  this 
extension. 

In  turn,  petitioner has  consented  to  a  fourteen-day  extension  of time  for  respondents  to  file 
their brief, to and including September 23,  2019. 

Thank you for your consideration . 

Very truly yours,
